purpose: Apply the V3 full historical polling collection and the exact frozen V3 trend anchor to matched V4 structural variants
metric: equal-weighted mean of within-object municipal MAE in percentage points
fixed_population: 66 voting objects, 23 complete dates, 138868 municipalities x objects, 2016-2022
data_selection: No new source collection or optimization. The V3 original and audited historical poll CSV are combined exactly as in enrichment_experiment_v3.polling_comparison. All variants retain objects with no polls.
selection_policy: Exploratory development ablation; report all scores including worse variants and do not promote without fresh prospective validation.
